From the director

A word from Effiom

I want to be honest with you about why I started this practice.

I've spent eight years in structural engineering and I've seen what the industry often gets wrong: clients treated as transactions, homeowners left confused by jargon, architects chasing engineers who don't return calls. I built ARX to be different from all of that.

When you work with me, I answer my phone. I explain things in plain English. If something is going to be a problem, I tell you early — not after the fact. If your vision isn't structurally possible the way you've imagined it, I don't just say no — I find you a way forward.

That's not a sales pitch. It's just how I think engineering should work. Every client — the homeowner removing a wall for the first time, the architect on their tenth project with me — gets the same thing: my full attention and my genuine best.

That's the promise. I keep it.

Effiom Esua BEng MSc · Director, ARX Engineers Ltd · Bristol

How I work with every client.

Not aspirations. Actual commitments.

I.
I anticipate, I don't just react.
You shouldn't need to know the right questions to ask a structural engineer. I ask them for you. Problems that I can see coming get flagged early — not after they've cost you time or money.
II.
I speak plainly, always.
No mystification. No jargon to make the work seem more complicated than it is. I explain what I'm designing, why it matters, and what it means for your build — in language that makes sense.
III.
I'm reachable. Genuinely.
Every enquiry gets a response the same day. Every question gets a proper answer. I know your project matters to you — that means it matters to me too. That's not a policy. It's just basic respect.
IV.
No is never just no.
If something can't be done the way you've imagined it, I tell you why — and then I find an alternative. There's always a way forward. My job is to find it with you, not to hand it back unsolved.

Husband.
Father.
Engineer.

Beyond the work

The same standards I bring to every project, I bring to everything that matters.

ARX is a one-man practice — and that man goes home every evening to a wife and two children under two. I know what it means to have something that matters deeply to you. I know the weight of responsibility.

That's why I take your project seriously. Not because it's policy. Because I understand that your home, your extension, your loft conversion — it's not just a building. It's where your life happens.

"I built this practice to give clients the kind of service I'd want for my own family. Someone you can trust. Someone who picks up the phone. Someone who actually cares."

Effiom, Talia, Idris & Maya · Bristol

What I
design

Structural engineering for homes and buildings across Bristol and the South West.

01
Loft Conversions
Hip-to-gable, dormer, mansard. Ridge beams, floor joists, staircase trimmers, masonry stability — the full structural package for Building Control.
02
Extensions
Single and two-storey rear extensions. Flat roof joists, opening beams, foundations, full stability design. Bi-fold and large sliding door frames too.
03
Internal Alterations
Wall removals, steel frames, lintel design, masonry bearings. I make open-plan possible — safely, with drawings your builder can actually follow.
04
New Builds
Additional storeys, outbuildings, full new-build structural packages. Every project led by me, from concept to Building Control submission.
05
Garage Conversions
Structural design for garage-to-habitable conversions. New openings, roof loads, foundation checks — everything Building Control needs.
06
Building Regulations Packages
Full calculation packages for Building Control. Structural drawings, key details and specifications — clear, compliant, and ready to submit.

How it works

Simple. Honest. No surprises.

From first message to finished drawings — here's what to expect.

1
You get in touch
A few details about your project is enough to start. I'll come back to you the same day, without fail.
2
I send a clear proposal
A detailed scope and a fixed fee. No hourly ambiguity. No hidden extras. You know exactly what you're getting before you commit.
3
I get to work
I keep you informed throughout. If anything changes or I spot something, I tell you immediately — not after the fact.
4
You get the package
Full Building Regulations calculations and drawings issued in PDF. Clear enough for your builder. Thorough enough for Building Control.
